persistenceRecovery.result: Selected one origin-scoped OPFS database, exact pinned/verified DuckDB-Wasm artifact, market-cycle durability boundary COMMIT→CHECKPOINT→acknowledgement, UNIQUE ingest_token reconciliation, explicit persistent/best-effort browser-storage state, non-destructive schema/reopen recovery and explicit storage-blocked behavior.
persistenceRecovery.sessionRecovery: Unclosed running recording sessions become interrupted without fabricated stop time; a new session starts after readiness.
persistenceRecovery.schedulerRecovery: Active query/version and original cadence anchor are restored; downtime ticks coalesce to at most one pending execution.
persistenceRecovery.quota: Quota/storage failures withhold success and block further successful recording; no silent history deletion.

engineSelection.versionRule: Pin exact artifact and prove write/CHECKPOINT/reopen in Chromium; do not trust floating version labels/tags.
